description: Where a specialist, diagnostic test or treatment paid by NFZ is available soonest near a place in Poland. Returns clinics and hospitals with NFZ's forecast waiting time, people in the queue, address, phone, distance, accessibility and whether children are seen. service: everyday words (okulista, kardiolog, rezonans, zaćma, rehabilitacja…) or an exact NFZ benefit name from find_benefits. place: town, address or 'lat,lon'.

benefit.description: Exact NFZ benefit name (from find_benefits / 'Inne pasujące świadczenia') – overrides service matching

children.description: Patient is a child – searches paediatric clinics

hospital.description: Hospital ward instead of an outpatient clinic

radius_km.description: Search radius in km (default 30, widened automatically if few results)

service.description: What is needed, e.g. 'okulista', 'ortopeda', 'rezonans magnetyczny', 'endoprotezoplastyka stawu biodrowego'

sort.description: 'wait' (default) = shortest waiting time first, 'distance' = nearest first

urgent.description: Urgent case (referral marked 'pilne'); default false = stable case

name: find_care
title: Shortest NFZ waiting times near a place
